about:
As the first AACSB-accredited MBA in Israel, and as part of our commitment to academic excellence, we ask all lecturers—from the Coller School of Management, visiting faculty from around the world, and industry experts—to meaningfully integrate ethics and ethical perspectives into their courses.
We also encourage our lecturers to bring an entrepreneurial mindset into the classroom, connect course content to the Israeli innovation ecosystem, and continuously update lectures, case studies, readings, and projects to reflect the rapidly evolving business landscape.

sections.name: Elective Courses
sections.note:
As a student in the Sofaer MBA, you will engage in both experiential and classroom-based learning. Many of our courses are designed to blend these approaches, allowing you to apply concepts in practice while reinforcing the tools and frameworks introduced throughout the program.
Our electives are refreshed each year to ensure they remain relevant, forward-looking, and closely aligned with today’s dynamic business environment—offering you an engaging and immersive learning experience that supports your professional growth.

sections.name: Core Courses
sections.note:
As the first AASCB accredited MBA in Israel, we offer all of the traditional core courses of top global MBAs, adding up to 16 credits. Due to our commitment to excellence, we have asked all lecturers from the Coller School of Management, visiting professors from around the world, and industry experts who teach our courses to integrate ethics and ethical approaches into their courses.
We expect our lecturers to add an entrepreneurial approach to their courses, tie them into the Israeli ecosystem, and update lectures, case studies, readings, and projects to reflect our ever-changing reality. Every year we connect our lecturers with one another, enabling them to build off of each other and refer to materials covered in other courses.

sections.name: Elective Courses
sections.note: As a student in the Sofaer Global MBA, you are expected to learn experientially as well as didactically. Many of our classes offer a unique combination of the two, and are intended to reinforce the synthesis of tools and frameworks delivered elsewhere in the curriculum that will help ensure your professional success. Our electives are updated each year and curated to offer the most relevant, up-to-date, and immersive experience possible.
